outputs.name: Note
outputs.description: Output based on the pitch of the triggered MIDI key.

outputs.name: Velocity
outputs.description: Output based on the pressure/velocity of the triggered MIDI key.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: The time it takes for the output to reach a new note's value.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: The time it takes for the output to return to its default state after a note is released.
